title: The Dark Knight — The Interrogation Room (v2)
subtitle: All-Nomad Leads · Shot-for-Shot 2.31:1 Scope · Hooman as Joker, Damon as Batman, Gigi as Gordon

shots.speaker: gigi
shots.cam: Wide OTS behind seated Joker silhouette toward heavy steel door as Gigi enters dark slate-lit room.
shots.dialogue: One, two, three, eyes on me, Joker. Where is Harvey Dent? And why does it smell like burnt saffron in here?
shots.tts: [stern Boonton principal authority cutting the quiet] One, two, three, eyes on me, Joker. Where is Harvey Dent? And why does it smell like burnt saffron in here?

shots.speaker: gigi
shots.cam: Medium shot Gigi seated across pitted metal table beside black desk lamp in dark interrogation room.
shots.dialogue: I don't play games after recess, mister. Start talking before Batman steps through that door.
shots.tts: [clipped no-nonsense teacher warning] I don't play games after recess, mister. Start talking before Batman steps through that door.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Tight dark-room CU on Hooman-Joker in purple coat half-carved by cyan ceiling bounce.
shots.dialogue: Chay-chay-chetori, Commissioner! Nobody give Hooman coffee, nobody take fifty-fifty deal, huuuuh?
shots.tts: Chay-chay-chetori, Commissioner! Nobody give Hooman coffee, nobody take fifty-fifty deal, huuuuh?

shots.speaker: gigi
shots.cam: Dark reverse CU on Gigi staring calmly under overhead observation glow.
shots.dialogue: Nobody is cutting a fifty-fifty real estate deal in Gotham Police. Hands flat on the steel table right now.
shots.tts: [dry flat police authority] Nobody is cutting a fifty-fifty real estate deal in Gotham Police. Hands flat on the steel table right now.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Dark CU on Hooman-Joker smirking in smeared white paint and purple coat.
shots.dialogue: Strict teacher routine very scary, dood! Call Zach, check Encino escrow before midnight!
shots.tts: Strict teacher routine very scary, dood! Call Zach, check Encino escrow before midnight!

shots.speaker: gigi
shots.cam: Tight dark CU on Gigi narrowing her eyes behind glasses.
shots.dialogue: Leave Zach out of this basement. Tell me where Harvey Dent is before I turn on the lights.
shots.tts: [tense urgent warning] Leave Zach out of this basement. Tell me where Harvey Dent is before I turn on the lights.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Head-tilted dark CU on Hooman-Joker grinning wickedly in shadows.
shots.dialogue: Oh, Harvey in lovely Westside spot, dood! Zero HOA fee, tiny bit asbestos, no problem!
shots.tts: Oh, Harvey in lovely Westside spot, dood! Zero HOA fee, tiny bit asbestos, no problem!

shots.speaker: gigi
shots.cam: Medium two-shot as Gigi leans forward to uncuff Hooman-Joker at the dark table.
shots.dialogue: Fine. You lost your green behavior star for the week. Let's see how you handle the night shift.
shots.tts: [cold exhausted disgust] Fine. You lost your green behavior star for the week. Let's see how you handle the night shift.

shots.speaker: gigi
shots.cam: Medium shot by heavy steel door looking back into dark room before flipping the breaker.
shots.dialogue: Good luck explaining escrow to him, Hooman. The lights are coming on now.
shots.tts: [icy parting shot at doorway] Good luck explaining escrow to him, Hooman. The lights are coming on now.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: HARD CUT FLASH: overhead white fluorescents slam on; Hooman-Joker in shirt & green vest with Damon-Batman looming right behind him.
shots.dialogue: Fuck that shit, Batman! Why you stand behind people in dark like Encino valet, dood?!
shots.tts: Fuck that shit, Batman! Why you stand behind people in dark like Encino valet, dood?!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Bright clinical OTS past Joker's messy curls onto Damon-Batman towering forward.
shots.dialogue: Where is Harvey Dent. And back up two inches—I'm fasting on cold Maurten hydrogels.
shots.tts: [deadpan restrained Batman growl] Where is Harvey Dent. And back up two inches—I'm fasting on cold Maurten hydrogels.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Bright clinical tight CU of Hooman-Joker raising hand after being slammed onto the table.
shots.dialogue: Never start with the head, dood! You mess up hairline—you know Beverly Hills hair plug cost?
shots.tts: Never start with the head, dood! You mess up hairline—you know Beverly Hills hair plug cost?

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Bright OTS over Hooman's green-curled head onto Damon-Batman glaring down.
shots.dialogue: Don't test my patience, Hooman. I raced Lake Placid Aquabike in pouring rain on worse.
shots.tts: [flat dry legal intensity] Don't test my patience, Hooman. I raced Lake Placid Aquabike in pouring rain on worse.

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Dark observation room side-angle: Deron in bamboo hat & dragon robe watching intently beside silent Gigi and Zach.
shots.dialogue: Aiya! Look at Damon shoulders so stiff lah! Somebody bring hot water and Po Chai Pill!
shots.tts: Aiya! Look at Damon shoulders so stiff lah! Somebody bring hot water and Po Chai Pill!

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Clean bright CU of Hooman-Joker seated upright against greenish-beige painted cinderblock.
shots.dialogue: Your friends behind mirror eating dumplings, baba! Tell Deron stop breathing on glass!
shots.tts: Your friends behind mirror eating dumplings, baba! Tell Deron stop breathing on glass!

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Tight OTS past Batman's black shoulder onto Hooman-Joker leaning forward squinting.
shots.dialogue: Wait a second... why your voice sound like treadmill at Equinox, dood? You sweating inside rubber suit?
shots.tts: Wait a second... why your voice sound like treadmill at Equinox, dood? You sweating inside rubber suit?

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Bright OTS over Joker curls onto Damon-Batman clenching his jaw under white lights.
shots.dialogue: Word. It's a Zone-five core hold and I had bad shrimp. Now give me Harvey's address.
shots.tts: [strained deadpan through gritted teeth] Word. It's a Zone-five core hold and I had bad shrimp. Now give me Harvey's address.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: OTS onto Hooman-Joker smirking across table toward Batman's dark silhouette.
shots.dialogue: Bad shrimp in neoprene suit? Brother, you need Magic Cone! Clean every pipe in one minute, dood!
shots.tts: Bad shrimp in neoprene suit? Brother, you need Magic Cone! Clean every pipe in one minute, dood!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Tight clinical medium CU of Damon-Batman staring dead ahead against flat beige wall.
shots.dialogue: Keep your funnel out of my interrogation. You have ten seconds before I lose my grip.
shots.tts: [low gravelly deadpan warning] Keep your funnel out of my interrogation. You have ten seconds before I lose my grip.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Medium bright CU of Hooman-Joker tilting head back with manic delighted grin.
shots.dialogue: Ooh! Big tough lawyer gonna lose grip! What you gonna do, sue me in Superior Court, huuuuh?
shots.tts: Ooh! Big tough lawyer gonna lose grip! What you gonna do, sue me in Superior Court, huuuuh?

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Bright OTS over Joker's curls onto Damon-Batman holding steady intensity.
shots.dialogue: I survived L.A. County jail—jail, never prison. You don't rattle me. Where are they?
shots.tts: [calm cold NJ courtroom cadence] I survived L.A. County jail—jail, never prison. You don't rattle me. Where are they?

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Bright CU of Hooman-Joker leaning back grinning, raising hand to collar.
shots.dialogue: Listen, baby—jail good for character! Tell Darren let's go fifty-fifty on Arkham parking structure!
shots.tts: Listen, baby—jail good for character! Tell Darren let's go fifty-fifty on Arkham parking structure!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Medium two-shot toward steel door: Damon-Batman confronting seated Joker across table.
shots.dialogue: Enough with Darren. Their clock is running out right now. Which warehouse?
shots.tts: [urgent clipped intensity] Enough with Darren. Their clock is running out right now. Which warehouse?

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Extreme tight OTS past foreground Joker curls straight onto Damon-Batman's glaring face.
shots.dialogue: Every second you stall, my stomach gets worse and your face hits this table harder.
shots.tts: [tight whispered menace] Every second you stall, my stomach gets worse and your face hits this table harder.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Side-tilted bright CU of Hooman-Joker nodding cheerfully under clinical white light.
shots.dialogue: See, madness like Encino brunch line, dood! All it takes is one bad burrito and little push!
shots.tts: See, madness like Encino brunch line, dood! All it takes is one bad burrito and little push!

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Dead-center bright CU of Hooman-Joker smiling chillingly wide in stained vest and paint.
shots.dialogue: Plus you have choice tonight, my friend... Harvey on Tenth Street, or Rachel eating warm guacamole!
shots.tts: Plus you have choice tonight, my friend... Harvey on Tenth Street, or Rachel eating warm guacamole!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Action medium two-shot: Damon-Batman slams Hooman-Joker upright against bright concrete pillar.
shots.dialogue: Tell me which one is where! Right now, Hooman!
shots.tts: [explosive bark slamming wall] Tell me which one is where! Right now, Hooman!

shots.speaker: zach
shots.cam: Observation room medium group angle: Zach glancing up from phone beside Gigi, Deron & silent officers.
shots.dialogue: OMG, wait—ChatGPT says throwing people into cinderblock walls spikes cortisol like crazy, literally lol!
shots.tts: [fast upbeat tech-bro commentary] OMG, wait—ChatGPT says throwing people into cinderblock walls spikes cortisol like crazy, literally lol!

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Pinned-to-wall OTS: Hooman-Joker laughing while Batman's armored glove holds his vest.
shots.dialogue: Ask Elon, dood! He already quote-tweeted Rachel address on X with blue check, huuuuh?!
shots.tts: Ask Elon, dood! He already quote-tweeted Rachel address on X with blue check, huuuuh?!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Tight fierce OTS onto Damon-Batman staring straight into Joker's eyes inches away.
shots.dialogue: Shut up about X. Give me both street names before I tear this wall down.
shots.tts: [fierce gravelly command] Shut up about X. Give me both street names before I tear this wall down.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Side profile two-shot against white brick wall: Batman gripping Hooman-Joker by collar.
shots.dialogue: Careful baby, you wrinkle tailored shirt! Harvey at Two-Fifty Fifty-Second, Rachel at Cicero dock!
shots.tts: Careful baby, you wrinkle tailored shirt! Harvey at Two-Fifty Fifty-Second, Rachel at Cicero dock!

shots.speaker: gigi
shots.cam: Dark observation room side-angle: Gigi leaning urgently toward the glass beside silent Zach and Deron.
shots.dialogue: Did that clown just brag about Elon Musk on police CCTV?! Breach that door immediately!
shots.tts: [furious righteous teacher outrage] Did that clown just brag about Elon Musk on police CCTV?! Breach that door immediately!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Tight OTS onto Damon-Batman glaring furiously before throwing Joker toward the table.
shots.dialogue: I'm going for Rachel. Stay right where you are.
shots.tts: [sharp cold finality] I'm going for Rachel. Stay right where you are.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: High angle on Hooman-Joker sprawled laughing sideways across the tilted steel table.
shots.dialogue: Hahaha! Don't forget stop at Sherman Oaks valet on way! And grab toilet paper, dood!
shots.tts: Hahaha! Don't forget stop at Sherman Oaks valet on way! And grab toilet paper, dood!

shots.speaker: deron
shots.cam: Outside frosted corridor glass door at night as Deron bangs on jammed steel frame.
shots.dialogue: Aiya! Why Batman wedge cheap folding chair under doorknob lah?! Worse security than Clippers bench!
shots.tts: Aiya! Why Batman wedge cheap folding chair under doorknob lah?! Worse security than Clippers bench!

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Medium shot Hooman-Joker slumped cheerfully against bright white brick wall looking up.
shots.dialogue: You see, Damon, their rules drop like old fiber bar! Look at them banging door outside!
shots.tts: You see, Damon, their rules drop like old fiber bar! Look at them banging door outside!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: High downward shot of Damon-Batman looming furiously in cape over floor.
shots.dialogue: You think any of this is funny? My glucose hit two hundred and I still run faster than them.
shots.tts: [hard cold deadpan glare] You think any of this is funny? My glucose hit two hundred and I still run faster than them.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Hooman-Joker grinning up from bright floor corner past Batman's dark forearm.
shots.dialogue: Hahaha! Nobody got anything to threaten Hooman with! Wait—tell Zach buy Magic Cone stock!
shots.tts: Hahaha! Nobody got anything to threaten Hooman with! Wait—tell Zach buy Magic Cone stock!

shots.speaker: damon
shots.cam: Tight fierce shot of Damon-Batman standing over floor before storming out.
shots.dialogue: I'm done talking. Enjoy solitary and stale meatloaf.
shots.tts: [final clipped Batman ultimatum] I'm done talking. Enjoy solitary and stale meatloaf.

shots.speaker: hooman
shots.cam: Closing low up-angle OTS past Batman's receding shoulder on Hooman-Joker gazing up smiling wide.
shots.dialogue: Don't leave so angry, baby! You complete Hooman... call Darren when bathroom break finish, huuuuh?
shots.tts: Don't leave so angry, baby! You complete Hooman... call Darren when bathroom break finish, huuuuh?
